title: Erebus: Last Watch
subtitle: Five consoles, one way down
description: A terminals demo. Take the cargo hauler Erebus through its last watch over Gordian Moon: wake the core, mark a place to land, open the bay, fly the drift, set the lander down.
author: Daniel Sandner
license: Apache-2.0, as CLIo is (the names are placeholders until the lore says otherwise)
help: On the bridge, 'orders' opens the watch's wheel. In a console: Esc is the menu, with its keys.
about: The terminals demo of the CLIo engine: consoles as panels, functions held and switched, scans of real ground, the view ahead in lines, models that move as values say, a wheel of orders.
